title: Teaching Children the Rights of the Deen and 'Ibadat
reference_info: حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين - عماد عبدالعظيم (الألوكة)

text_simplified: Parents must teach their children the rights of the Deen and 'ibadat from a young age. They should also be a good example in adhering to Salah and akhlaq. Tarbiyah of children upon religious values strengthens their positive behavior.

review_defects.why: Transliteration of العبادات is capitalized as 'Ibadat in the title but appears as lowercase 'ibadat in the body text, creating inconsistency within the same document.
Transliterated term 'Salah' is capitalized mid-sentence while other transliterated terms like 'akhlaq' are lowercase, inconsistent capitalization.
